svg.title: Investigating suspected ischemic heart disease decision chart: the pretest probability picks the test, from no testing in asymptomatic low-risk patients, to CT coronary angiography as a test of exclusion, to exercise or pharmacologic stress testing at intermediate probability, to coronary angiography after a high-risk result; for chambers, valves and left ventricular function the gold-standard imaging test is chosen by the structure
